seats.Daisuke: Cares about long-term financial commitments and budget sources. He looks for options that utilize existing ring-fenced funds to avoid future arguments.
seats.Toshio: Cares about hidden physical risks and administrative hurdles. He evaluates options based on the ease of obtaining consents and the predictability of the site.
seats.Takumi: Cares about institutional memory and past performance. He looks for evidence from previous pilots and closure reports to avoid repeating mistakes.
seats.Sakura: Cares about actual passenger time loss versus perceived crowding. She seeks options that address the real bottlenecks identified in journey audits.
seats.Victoria: Cares about the availability of personnel to operate the plan. She examines roster capacity and maintenance contracts to ensure the plan is staffable.
